70325-mary-christmas.title: Mary Christmas
70325-mary-christmas.creator: Mary Ellen Chase
70325-mary-christmas.description: A book by Mary Ellen Chase. n a certain warm day very early in the month of June, the four Wescott children, who were swinging on a white gate beneath great elm trees, were startled by the most curious and, for the duration of a long half-hour, quite inexplicable behavior on the part of their father.

75720-jack-pumpkinhead-of-oz.title: Jack Pumpkinhead Of Oz
75720-jack-pumpkinhead-of-oz.creator: Unknown
75720-jack-pumpkinhead-of-oz.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The rain beat heavily on the roof, swirled down the side walks and made tumbling torrents of the gutters. Turning from the window in disgust, Peter dropped his baseball mitt on the library sofa and started glumly toward the stair. No practice to-day, doggone it! Why couldn't it rain on Mondays and be clear on Saturdays for a change? How was he to have the team in trim for the big match if this sort of thing kept up?

arxiv-2102-12259.title: Probing neutrino magnetic moment at the Jinping neutrino experiment
arxiv-2102-12259.creator: Baobiao Yue, Jiajun Liao, Jiajie Ling
arxiv-2102-12259.description: Abstract Neutrino magnetic moment ( ν \nu MM) is an important property of massive neutrinos. The recent anomalous excess at few keV electronic recoils observed by the Xenon1T collaboration might indicate a ∼ 2.2 × 10 − 11 ​ μ B \sim 2.

arxiv-2312-04648.title: Enhancing Polynomial Chaos Expansion Based Surrogate Modeling using a Novel Probabilistic Transfer Learning Strategy
arxiv-2312-04648.creator: Wyatt Bridgman, Uma Balakrishnan, Reese Jones, Jiefu Chen, Xuqing Wu, Cosmin Safta, Yueqin Huang, Mohammad Khalil
arxiv-2312-04648.description: Abstract In the field of surrogate modeling, polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) allows practitioners to construct inexpensive yet accurate surrogates to be used in place of the expensive forward model simulations. For black-box simulations, non-intrusive PCE allows the construction of these surrogates using a set of simulation response evaluations.

arxiv-2402-02259.title: CENTRAL LIMIT THEOREM FOR RÉNYI DIVERGENCE OF INFINITE ORDER Thanks: 1) School of Mathematics, University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, MN, USA, bobkov@math.umn.edu. Thanks: 2) Faculty of Mathematics, Bielefeld University, Germany, goetze@math-uni.bielefeld.de.
arxiv-2402-02259.creator: S. G. Bobkov 1, F. Götze 2
arxiv-2402-02259.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by S. G. Bobkov 1, F. Götze 2. For normalized sums Z n Z_{n} of i.i.d. random variables, we explore necessary and sufficient conditions which guarantee the normal approximation with respect to the Rényi divergence of infinite order.

arxiv-2407-17766.title: Strategic Pseudo-Goal Perturbation for Deadlock-Free Multi-Agent Navigation in Social Mini-Games
arxiv-2407-17766.creator: Abhishek Jha*, Tanishq Gupta, Sumit Singh Rawat, Girish Kumar
arxiv-2407-17766.description: Abstract This work introduces a Strategic Pseudo-Goal Perturbation (SPGP) technique, a novel approach to resolve deadlock situations in multi-agent navigation scenarios. Leveraging the robust framework of Safety Barrier Certificates, our method integrates a strategic perturbation mechanism that guides agents through social mini-games where deadlock and collision occur frequently.

arxiv-2506-04454.title: Neurosymbolic Artificial Intelligence for Robust Network Intrusion Detection: From Scratch to Transfer Learning
arxiv-2506-04454.creator: Huynh T. T. Tran, Jacob Sander, Achraf Cohen, Brian Jalaian, Nathaniel D. Bastian
arxiv-2506-04454.description: Abstract Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) play a vital role in protecting digital infrastructures against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. In this paper, we extend ODXU , a Neurosymbolic AI (NSAI) framework that integrates deep embedded clustering for feature extraction, symbolic reasoning using XGBoost, and comprehensive uncertainty quantification (UQ) to enhance robustness, interpretability, and generalization in NIDS.

arxiv-2507-15817.title: Charge density wave in intermetallic oxides R 5 Pb 3 O (R = La and Ce)
arxiv-2507-15817.creator: Rafaela F. S. Penacchio, Siham Mohamed, Haley A. Harms, Lin-Lin Wang, Sergey L. Bud’ko, Paul C. Canfield, Tyler J. Slade
arxiv-2507-15817.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rafaela F. S. Penacchio, Siham Mohamed, Haley A. Harms, Lin-Lin Wang, Sergey L. Bud’ko, Paul C. Canfield, Tyler J. Slade. The R 5 Pb 3 O family was discovered decades ago, but has remained largely unexplored. Here, we report single crystal growth and basic characterization for the La and Ce members of this family.

arxiv-2508-10318.title: Quantifying the Value of Seismic Structural Health Monitoring for post-earthquake recovery of electric power system in terms of resilience enhancement
arxiv-2508-10318.creator: Huangbin Liang, Beatriz Moya, Francisco Chinesta, Eleni Chatzi
arxiv-2508-10318.description: Abstract Post-earthquake recovery of electric power networks (EPNs) is critical to community resilience. Traditional recovery processes often rely on prolonged and imprecise manual inspections for damage diagnosis, leading to suboptimal repair prioritization and extended service disruptions. Seismic Structural Health Monitoring (SSHM) offers the potential to expedite post-earthquake recovery by enabling more accurate and timely damage assessment.

pmc-10665748.title: The prediction model of operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia stage III-IV: A multicenter study
pmc-10665748.creator: Song Wang, Meng Qian, Min Wu, Shuo Feng, Kaiguang Zhang
pmc-10665748.description: PurposeIntestinal metaplasia plays a crucial role in the risk stratification of gastric cancer development. The objective of the study was to develop a prediction model for Operative Link on Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia (OLGIM) Stage III-IV.MethodsWe analyzed 7945 high-risk gastric cancer individuals from 115 hospitals who underwent questionnaires and gastroscope.

pmc-11510915.title: Experimental Study of Hot-Sphere Anemometer Response in Stratospheric Environment
pmc-11510915.creator: Xiyuan Li, Xiaoning Yang, Xiaobin Shen, Guiping Lin, Dongxing Tao, Jing Wang
pmc-11510915.description: Accurate wind speed measurement in low-pressure conditions is crucial for the thermal performance validation and attitude control of stratospheric aircraft. As air density decreases, traditional wind speed measurement systems based on principles such as dynamic pressure, heat transfer, ultrasound, and particle velocimetry face significant challenges when applied in low-pressure environments, often failing to achieve the required measurement accuracy.

pmc-11579820.title: The effect of group size on sleep in a neotropical bat, Artibeus jamaicensis
pmc-11579820.creator: Alexis M. Heckley, Christian D. Harding, Rachel A. Page, Barrett A. Klein, Yossi Yovel, Clarice A. Diebold, Hannah B. Tilley
pmc-11579820.description: Sleep is associated with many costs, but is also important to survival, with a lack of sleep impairing cognitive function and increasing mortality. Sleeping in groups could alleviate sleep‐associated costs, or could introduce new costs if social sleeping disrupts sleep.

pmc-11648627.title: Dynamical theory of complex systems with two-way micro–macro causation
pmc-11648627.creator: John Harte, Micah Brush, Kaito Umemura, Pranav Muralikrishnan, Erica A. Newman
pmc-11648627.description: SignificanceComplex systems can often be conceptualized at both a microlevel (for example, molecules of a gas) and a macrolevel (for example, pressure and temperature of the gas). Bottom–Up, agent-based mechanistic modeling and Top–Down, statistical inference are the two dominant approaches to modeling such systems.

pmc-12736323.title: Senotherapeutics for Brain Aging Management
pmc-12736323.creator: Timur Saliev, Prim B Singh, Junji Yamauchi
pmc-12736323.description: Brain aging is a progressive process marked by cellular dysfunction, chronic inflammation, and increased susceptibility to neurodegenerative diseases. A growing body of evidence identifies cellular senescence, the accumulation of non-dividing, metabolically active cells with a pro-inflammatory secretory profile (SASP), as a key contributor to cognitive decline and brain aging.

pmc-13051904.title: Nephrotic–Nephritic Syndrome Following Unilateral Nephrectomy in Wilms Tumour in a Child
pmc-13051904.creator: Rawshan Zuhair Jaber, Poorani Gurumallesh Prabu
pmc-13051904.description: BackgroundWilms tumour (WT) represents the most frequent kidney malignant tumour in the paediatric population and is occasionally linked to specific congenital syndromes. Treatment typically includes multimodal therapy consisting of chemotherapy, surgery and/or radiotherapy (RT), with a success rate of approximately 90%. The incidence of nephrotic–nephritic syndrome following unilateral nephrectomy is extremely rare; however, certain long‐term kidney complications have been documented.

pmc-13246407.title: Case Report: dynamic monocyte reprogramming during ALSS therapy in type B HBV-ACLF revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
pmc-13246407.creator: Jiale Xie, Jiahua Liu, Feiyu Wang, Dongxuan Zhang, Yuyao Tian, Júlio Ken Matsubara, Jingxiang Zhang, Jie Yin, Zian Chen, Huimin Liu, Xiaoshuang Xu, Xin Wang, Guifen Liu, Jianhua Wang, Yansheng Jia, Lili Chang, Yu Guo, Wei Qi, Yan Wang
pmc-13246407.description: BackgroundHepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) is characterized by intense systemic inflammation and immune dysregulation, with monocytes playing a central role in its progression. Patients with HBV-ACLF typically receive comprehensive treatment including artificial liver support system (ALSS). Here, we report a case of HBV-ACLF in which single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) showing dynamic reprogramming of monocyte upon ALSS treatment.

pmc-13273090.title: Redefinition of Stemonosudis intermedia (Ege, 1933) and description of a new species from the western Atlantic Ocean (Aulopiformes: Paralepididae)
pmc-13273090.creator: Hsuan‐Ching Ho, Katherine E Bemis
pmc-13273090.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We examined specimens of slender barracudina in the genus Stemonosudis collected from the western Atlantic Ocean. Investigation revealed that seven specimens represent the first adult records of Stemonosudis intermedia (Ege, 1933), previously known only from juveniles. intermedia based on the holotype and newly recognized adult and juvenile specimens, and using this ontogenetic series, we document changes in coloration from light‐brown juveniles to black adults. We also determined that some specimens from the western Atlantic Ocean previously identified as S.

pmc-13430408.title: Dendritic cell redundancy enables priming of anti-tumor CD4+ T cells in pancreatic cancer
pmc-13430408.creator: Courtney TS Kureshi, Michael J Walsh, Rakeeb Kureshi, Victoire Cardot-Ruffino, Dennis A Agardy, Lestat R Ali, James M Dougan, Li Qiang, Jiao Shen, Chong Zuo, Patrick J Lenehan, S Jennifer Wang, Eugena Chang, Joshua Remland, Lauren Brais, Thomas E Clancy, James M Cleary, Jason L Hornick, Brandon M Hu
pmc-13430408.description: SUMMARYPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is resistant to current immunotherapies and lacks effective antitumor CD8+ T cells, which is potentially due to insufficient cross-presentation by cDC1s. Here, we combine a STING agonist with anti-CTLA-4 and anti-PD-1 to achieve durable remissions and immunologic memory in multiple mouse models of poorly immunogenic PDAC.

pmc-13472590.title: Cystine-Binding Medication Is Poorly Accessible for the Treatment of Cystinuria
pmc-13472590.creator: Xuemi Peng, Bart Penninx, Roos F. Marsman, Giovanna Capolongo, Marie Courbebaisse, Bertrand Knebelmann, Francesco Trepiccione, Francesco Emma, Aude Servais, Carla E.M. Hollak, Elena N. Levtchenko, Rik H.G. Olde Engberink
pmc-13472590.description: IntroductionCystinuria is a rare inherited disorder characterized by recurrent cystine stone formation. When lifestyle modification and urine alkalinization fail, cystine-binding medication such as tiopronin and D-penicillamine are indicated. Despite proven benefit, their accessibility across Europe appears limited. We hypothesized that access to this medication is restricted and varies substantially between European countries.
